name: Charon's Echo
description: Death, reimagined. Your items go to a grave in Charon's dusk-lit graveyard dimension — cross the portal as a ghost and settle with the Ferryman: pay the fare, pay the toll, or enlist in the war of the dead. Every death digs a headstone; the graveyard is the history of your server. Server-side, crossplay-ready (Geyser/Bedrock), no client mod required.
